sloka: अथ तस्य अप्रमेयस्य वचनम् परिपृच्छतः ।विश्वामित्रो महातेजा व्याख्यातुम् उपचक्रमे ॥१-२९-१॥
transliteration: atha tasya aprameyasya vacanam paripṛcchataḥ ।viśvāmitro mahātejā vyākhyātum upacakrame ॥1-29-1॥

translations.english: The highly lustrous Viswamitra heard the words of Rama of immeasurable prowess. On his (Rama's) query about the forest, Viswamitra explains.
